name: taskboard
description: Read and work a group's Task board via `tclaude agent taskboard`: see what your group is doing now and next (ls, show, activity, comment), capture and order tasks (add, edit, move, promote, demote, block, drop, done), track your own work (add it assigned to yourself), take an unassigned task or have one assigned to you, and report done or failed on it (take, release, report), and give the operator a task your work waits on (add --assignee operator --blocks), or ask the operator a question with choices on a task and get the answer back (ask-operator <task> [--wait]). Use when a `[taskboard]` mail arrives in your inbox, when the operator or your lead says "put it on the board", "what's next for the group", "take the next task", "track your work on the board", or when you finish or give up on a task you were assigned. Not the backlog: long-term work belongs in the external tracker (awb, Linear or similar). Not for Collab drawing boards (that is agent-drawing-board) or the task-reference link (agent-task).

findings.excerpt: tclaude agent taskboard ls                 # your group's board: the queue (next), then ideas (--backlog: the parked tasks too)
tclaude agent taskboard add <group> "fix the flaky retry test" --ref tcl-a1b2c3   # assigned to you, in progress
tclaude agent taskboard add <group> "Which colour for the lane?" --body "amber or purple; see the mock" \
tclaude agent taskboard add <group> "title" [--ref tcl-a1b2c3|LIN-12|URL] [--next] [--body-file brief.md] [--attach shot.png]…
tclaude agent taskboard add <group> "Tint the operator's lane" --body-file brief.md --attach mock.png
tclaude agent taskboard add <group> "title" --process X   # adds the task and starts X for it now
tclaude agent taskboard backlog tk_…              # park it (move --stage backlog does the same)
